_purpose: Stage 5 failure-injection suite (E4). Expected statuses are PRE-REGISTERED: written and committed BEFORE any Stage 5 code. Rule: if a case does not realise its intended scenario, its PARAMETERS may be adjusted (with a logged reason in docs/STAGE5_PLAN.md); an expected STATUS may never be changed to fit what the code does.

_semantics.tool_call_unit: one simulation attempt = 2 tool calls (generate_netlist + run_ngspice); a two-phase strategy (curvature/window) attempt = 4; persist_provenance = 1 and is RESERVED up front so persistence is never blocked by budget.
_semantics.retry_unit: each recovery action (re-run after a fault, solver-ladder step, window refinement after an SS refusal) is one retry; limit = budget.max_retries.
_semantics.points_unit: budget.max_points limits the size of the FINAL retained dataset (refinement adds points to it); failed attempts cost tool calls, retries and wall-clock but not points.
_semantics.wallclock: budget.max_runtime_s is the TOTAL deadline for the whole run, retries included, measured from run start. First process timeout = min(remaining, 0.4 * max_runtime_s); each timeout-retry doubles the previous timeout, capped at remaining.
_semantics.injection_modes: transient = the fault occurs on the FIRST attempt only; persistent = on EVERY attempt.

status_rules.rejected_invalid_input: the planner refused the spec as invalid; the simulator was never called
status_rules.successful: no fault event; output validated; EVERY requested measurement ok
status_rules.recovered_after_failure: >= 1 recognised-fault recovery event, final output validated, EVERY requested measurement ok; the chain is recorded
status_rules.partially_completed: output validated; >= 1 measurement ok and >= 1 refused and no recovery was possible or left
status_rules.failed: no usable output, OR a non-recoverable / unrecognised fault, OR the recovery ladder is exhausted while retries remain, OR every measurement refused
status_rules.stopped_budget_limit: a recovery was needed but a budget dimension (retries, tool calls, wall-clock) would be exceeded, OR the plan itself exceeds a budget
status_rules.precedence: if both the ladder and the retry budget are exhausted at once, the status is stopped_budget_limit

_semantics.solver_ladder: step 1: raise iteration limits (itl1/itl2/itl4); step 2: method=gear. NEVER gmin/abstol (changing them re-creates the Stage-1 IOFF artefact).
_semantics.base_spec: SKY130 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8, W=1 um, L=0.18 um, T=27 C, Id-Vg, VDS=1.8 V, VGS 0..1.8 V, measurements [VTH,SS,GM,ION,IOFF], ion_vgs_v=1.8, ioff_vgs_v=0.0, uniform strategy unless stated, sweep.points=N, budget defaults except where stated

_invariants: consumed tool calls, retries, points and wall-clock never exceed their limits (any case)
status SUCCESSFUL never appears when an injected fault was not handled (any case)
every executed case has a provenance record whose manifest verifies
no state is emitted without its evidence in the event log
